segment.source: ::He completely ignores you.::<end>
segment.target: ::He completely ignores you.::<end>

segment.source:
::You see this person nonchalantly watching other people in the courtyard. He has a self-satisfied smile on his face while eyeing everyone around him, and he also seems to hold his chin steadily elevated, as if posing for a sculptor to transfer it onto an elaborate bust. Interestingly, he seems astounded when you come near him and attempt to start a conversation. Your approach is met with a puzzled gawk, followed by him looking down at his body for some, to you, unknown reason. He then lifts his head up and speaks to you.::
You... you can see me?<end>
segment.target:

segment.source: Yup. You seem pretty visible to me.<end>
segment.target: Yup. You seem pretty visible to me.<end>

segment.source:
::He ponders the situation for a moment.::
The only *reasonable* explanation for you being able to see me must be that you possess some special gift... some special power, *mortal.* Yes... yes! That must be it!<end>
segment.target:
::He ponders the situation for a moment.::
The only *reasonable* explanation for you being able to see me must be that you possess some special gift... some special power, *mortal.* Yes... yes! That must be it!<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: Oh... That's good to know. Who are you anyway?<end>
segment.target: Oh... That's good to know. Who are you anyway?<end>

segment.source: I'm Cale, the Lord of Invisibility. I am the only one who has truly mastered the art of being in a state of gone - complete invisibility to the naked eye. "Gone" is the proper term for such state, and it was I who came up with it.<end>
segment.target: I'm Cale, the Lord of Invisibility. I am the only one who has truly mastered the art of being in a state of gone - complete invisibility to the naked eye. "Gone" is the proper term for such state, and it was I who came up with it.<end>

segment.source: That sounds pretty cool.<end>
segment.target: That sounds pretty cool.<end>

segment.source:
Of course, I can see how such divine things can impress a mortal being... such as yourself.
Yes... would you be so kind to tell me your name?<end>
segment.target:
Of course, I can see how such divine things can impress a mortal being... such as yourself.
Yes... would you be so kind to tell me your name?<end>

segment.source: It's $(context.player.Name).<end>
segment.target: It's $(context.player.Name).<end>

segment.source: $(context.player.Name), you say. A mortal name indeed. Well, let's talk about that gift of yours, shall we?<end>
segment.target: $(context.player.Name), you say. A mortal name indeed. Well, let's talk about that gift of yours, shall we?<end>

segment.source: Let's...<end>
segment.target: Let's...<end>

segment.source: Tell me of this gift of yours. When did you first realize you were able to see invisible people?<end>
segment.target: Tell me of this gift of yours. When did you first realize you were able to see invisible people?<end>

segment.source: If you can see someone then he is not invisible.<end>
segment.target: If you can see someone then he is not invisible.<end>

segment.source: You don't seem to understand the question, I... ugh... Working with mortals is painful...<end>
segment.target: You don't seem to understand the question, I... ugh... Working with mortals is painful...<end>

segment.source: Let's try it like this: I am invisible; you can see me. Therefore, since common mortals can't see me, but you can - you must have some special ability which allows you to do so. That is the only logical conclusion. And if you...<end>
segment.target: Let's try it like this: I am invisible; you can see me. Therefore, since common mortals can't see me, but you can - you must have some special ability which allows you to do so. That is the only logical conclusion. And if you...<end>

segment.source:
::He stops speaking. As his eyes shift away from you he begins scratching his beard. Soon after, he points his finger at you and speaks.::
I understand now why you're so confused! HA! You haven't had the opportunity to see an invisible person because there wasn't an invisible person to see! <end>
segment.target:
::He stops speaking. As his eyes shift away from you he begins scratching his beard. Soon after, he points his finger at you and speaks.::
I understand now why you're so confused! HA! You haven't had the opportunity to see an invisible person because there wasn't an invisible person to see! <end>

segment.source: I think I'm starting to lose you.<end>
segment.target: I think I'm starting to lose you.<end>

segment.source: You are a *mortal* so its not surprising to me. Now, where was I...<end>
segment.target: You are a *mortal* so its not surprising to me. Now, where was I...<end>

segment.source: You cannot answer my question about first noticing you had a gift which allows you to see invisible people because you never had the opportunity to see an invisible person. I - Cale, the Lord of Invisibility - am the first invisible person you *were* able to see and that is why the existence of your gift seems to perplex you so much.<end>
segment.target: You cannot answer my question about first noticing you had a gift which allows you to see invisible people because you never had the opportunity to see an invisible person. I - Cale, the Lord of Invisibility - am the first invisible person you *were* able to see and that is why the existence of your gift seems to perplex you so much.<end>

segment.source: For one to know if he is capable of seeing invisible people, he must first see someone who is invisible so that his mind can confirm that he had seen someone invisible, but since he could never see anyone invisible because there wasn't anyone invisible to see, then that one is unaware of his ability to see invisible people; so when he finally has an invisible person to see and he sees it, he doesn't attribute that to the fact that he is able to see invisible people but considers the invisible person to be visible to everyone.<end>

segment.source: But, that still doesn't answer how you are able to see me... or the origin of your gift... *mortal.* Well, since you seem to have no frickin' clue what I'm even talking about I suppose you won't be of much help, so we better leave it at this. I'll just disregard you as an anomaly and stop concerning myself with it.<end>

I'll just disregard you as an anomaly and stop concerning myself with it.<end>

segment.source: I understood nothing of what you just said.<end>
segment.target: I understood nothing of what you just said.<end>

segment.source: Typical mortal...<end>
segment.target: Typical mortal...<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: You were interested in my "gift," as you call it?<end>
segment.target: You were interested in my "gift," as you call it?<end>

segment.source: Yes, *mortal.* If it wasn't for it we most likely wouldn't be having this conversation right now; me being completely invisible would prevent you from noticing me, naturally.<end>
segment.target: Yes, *mortal.* If it wasn't for it we most likely wouldn't be having this conversation right now; me being completely invisible would prevent you from noticing me, naturally.<end>

segment.source: If you call everyone "mortal," does that mean that you are immortal?<end>
segment.target: If you call everyone "mortal," does that mean that you are immortal?<end>

segment.source: But of course - I am special! Do you think this ability that was bestowed upon me would fit a mortal man? Just... wasted once I - Cale, the Lord of Invisibility - perishes? No, that is not how this things work, mortal, and I don't expect you to understand.<end>
segment.target: But of course - I am special! Do you think this ability that was bestowed upon me would fit a mortal man? Just... wasted once I - Cale, the Lord of Invisibility - perishes? No, that is not how this things work, mortal, and I don't expect you to understand.<end>

segment.source: How can you be so sure?<end>
segment.target: How can you be so sure?<end>

segment.source: ::He rolls his eyes.:: You and your mortal questions. "How are you so sure?" I am sure because what I possess should not be possessed by a *mortal* man. And if it is not for mortal men - then I am not mortal. Do you understand?<end>
segment.target: ::He rolls his eyes.:: You and your mortal questions. "How are you so sure?" I am sure because what I possess should not be possessed by a *mortal* man. And if it is not for mortal men - then I am not mortal. Do you understand?<end>

segment.source: But, why exactly shouldn't a mortal man have the power to be invisible?<end>
segment.target: But, why exactly shouldn't a mortal man have the power to be invisible?<end>

segment.source: Because mortal people are regular people, common - and common men cannot enter the state of gone. I - Cale, the Lord of Invisiblity am special, can enter the state of gone, therefore I am not mortal. Simple logic... *mortal.*<end>
segment.target: Because mortal people are regular people, common - and common men cannot enter the state of gone. I - Cale, the Lord of Invisiblity am special, can enter the state of gone, therefore I am not mortal. Simple logic... *mortal.*<end>

segment.source: Now stop bothering me with these silly questions.<end>
segment.target: Now stop bothering me with these silly questions.<end>

segment.source: Yeah, yeah... I had other questions.<end>
segment.target: Yeah, yeah... I had other questions.<end>

segment.source: Yes, *mortal*?<end>
segment.target: Yes, *mortal*?<end>

segment.source: Can you tell me more about your invisibility and gone?<end>
segment.target: Can you tell me more about your invisibility and gone?<end>

segment.source:
It might be too much for your *mortal* brain to handle, so I'll explain it to you in *mortal* terms. I was born special: When I was five, I noticed that when I focused really, really hard I could become invisible. People walked past me like I wasn't there - like I was completely... gone! The older I got, the easier it became for me to enter the state of gone. Therefore, I entered it more often, naturally.
By now, I have pretty much perfected my craft. Well... *you* can see me, but you must possess something special which allows you so.<end>
segment.target:

segment.source: What if people just ignored you?<end>
segment.target: What if people just ignored you?<end>

segment.source:
Impossible! It would mean that all those mortals had to know *exactly* when I was focusing really hard to enter the state of gone, and then simultaneously decide to ignore me. That sounds... well, retarded!
The only logical explanation is that I became truly invisible to them.<end>

segment.source: Why did you call it "gone"?<end>
segment.target: Why did you call it "gone"?<end>

segment.source: I liked the way it sounded... Gone... Gone! Don't you hear the majesticness? No? Never mind then...<end>
segment.target: I liked the way it sounded... Gone... Gone! Don't you hear the majesticness? No? Never mind then...<end>

segment.source: Couldn't you pick a better name than "gone"?<end>
segment.target: Couldn't you pick a better name than "gone"?<end>

segment.source: That's very interesting, but I had other questions.<end>
segment.target: That's very interesting, but I had other questions.<end>

segment.source: Let's hear them.<end>
segment.target: Let's hear them.<end>

segment.source: Why are you here and what do you know about this place?<end>
segment.target: Why are you here and what do you know about this place?<end>

segment.source: I am here to show my power to the Tchortists. Unlike you, *mortals,* I can go everywhere I like without being detected by *mortal* eyes. I am special! With that said, I believe these Tchortists - who seem to love praising powerful entities - should be presented with an invisible man. ME. As soon as I decide to reveal myself they will most certainly praise *me* and I will be granted entry into this glorious building.<end>

As soon as I decide to reveal myself they will most certainly praise *me* and I will be granted entry into this glorious building.<end>

segment.source: But why Tchortists? Couldn't you find someone else to praise you?<end>
segment.target: But why Tchortists? Couldn't you find someone else to praise you?<end>

segment.source: Filth! I - Cale, the Lord of Invisibility - dislike everything Underrail has to offer - everything but the Tchort institute... or whatever it is called. This building is worthy of being my residence - and so it shall be once Tchortists see the invisible man - ME! They must live in abundance, and I deserve only the best.<end>

segment.source: I hope that answers your question, *mortal.*<end>
segment.target: I hope that answers your question, *mortal.*<end>

segment.source: I had other questions.<end>
segment.target: I had other questions.<end>

segment.source: What do you know about the Tchortists?<end>
segment.target: What do you know about the Tchortists?<end>

segment.source: While they are mere *mortals,* which usually aren't worth my time, these Tchortists seem very religious to me. They praise this Tchort *something,* and that's all I know about them. Now, once I show them what I - Cale, the Lord of Invisibility - am capable of...<end>

segment.source: Invisibility?<end>
segment.target: Invisibility?<end>

segment.source: Well, of course. Do I have to explain everything to you... *mortals*? Where was I... Oh, never mind.<end>
segment.target: Well, of course. Do I have to explain everything to you... *mortals*? Where was I... Oh, never mind.<end>

segment.source: How about we change the subject.<end>
segment.target: How about we change the subject.<end>

segment.source: Did you perhaps see any of the Tchortists carrying a strange artifact? It looks like a twenty-sided polyhedron.<end>
segment.target: Did you perhaps see any of the Tchortists carrying a strange artifact? It looks like a twenty-sided polyhedron.<end>

segment.source: Hmmm... I don't remember seeing what you describe, no.<end>
segment.target: Hmmm... I don't remember seeing what you describe, no.<end>

segment.source: To be honest, most of the time I don't concern myself with *mortal* affairs. It's beneath me.<end>
segment.target: To be honest, most of the time I don't concern myself with *mortal* affairs. It's beneath me.<end>

segment.source: Goodbye, Cale.<end>
segment.target: Goodbye, Cale.<end>

segment.source: Goodbye, mortal.<end>
segment.target: Goodbye, mortal.<end>

segment.source: I think it's best if we discuss something else.<end>
segment.target: I think it's best if we discuss something else.<end>

segment.source: If we must.<end>
segment.target: If we must.<end>

segment.source: What?<end>
segment.target: What?<end>

segment.source: This is too confusing; can we change the subject?<end>
segment.target: This is too confusing; can we change the subject?<end>

segment.source: Confusing? ::He laughs.:: Perhaps to you - but not to me!<end>
segment.target: Confusing? ::He laughs.:: Perhaps to you - but not to me!<end>

segment.source: By the way, we are not changing the subject - I am not done with this yet!<end>
segment.target: By the way, we are not changing the subject - I am not done with this yet!<end>

segment.source: I was never able to see invisible people.<end>
segment.target: I was never able to see invisible people.<end>

segment.source: I had some questions first.<end>
segment.target: I had some questions first.<end>

segment.source: Fine, fine... Ask your petty questions.<end>
segment.target: Fine, fine... Ask your petty questions.<end>

segment.source: I'd rather not.<end>
segment.target: I'd rather not.<end>

segment.source: Fine! To be honest, it's probably some simple mortal name like $(#Bob/Susan) or $(#Mike/Ann)... I'm more interested in that ability of yours, the one that allows you to see me.<end>
segment.target: Fine! To be honest, it's probably some simple mortal name like $(#Bob/Susan) or $(#Mike/Ann)... I'm more interested in that ability of yours, the one that allows you to see me.<end>

segment.source: Oh divine one, that is indeed something I want to know more about!<end>

Yes... would you be so kind to tell me your name?<end>

segment.source: ::Laugh.:: Well, it ain't working, pal!<end>
segment.target: ::Laugh.:: Well, it ain't working, pal!<end>

segment.source:
::He frowns.:: You know what? I have no wish to speak to you anymore. I will not be laughed at nor ridiculed by a mere *mortal*!
Good-bye!<end>

segment.source: ::Leave and say nothing.::<end>

segment.source: Oh divine one, it is an honor to be in your presence!<end>
segment.target: Oh divine one, it is an honor to be in your presence!<end>

segment.source:
::He simply couldn't hide his smug smile.:: Oh... yes... I like the sound of *that*! Divine one...
Allow me to introduce myself...<end>

segment.source: You've lost your marbles a long time ago, man.<end>
segment.target: You've lost your marbles a long time ago, man.<end>

segment.source:
What did you say to me, you... you... petty $(#caveman/cavewoman)! I simply can't believe it!
We are done here, *mortal.* I might not be invisible to *you,* but from now on, you'll be invisible to *me*!<end>

segment.source: ::He slaps your hand.:: Stop that! I will not allow some... petty *mortal* to touch me. How dare you!?<end>

segment.source: Whoa, are you invisible!?<end>
segment.target: Whoa, are you invisible!?<end>

segment.source: Well, not to you it seems! It... It's very strange...<end>

segment.source: No, I can't! What is going on? Where are you, where are you!?<end>

segment.source: Listen, *mortal,* I don't like being ridiculed! Not by you or anyone else, for that matter! It's quite obvious that you can see me... I am just at a loss at how is such a thing is even possible...<end>
